question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'massive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Massive** means very large in size, amount, or number.

 **• Example- **Eight massive stone pillars supported the roof.

 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'massive'.**

The** complete sentence** is- *The major causes of pollution include massive__ use of motor vehicles,...*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bulky **means large and heavy and therefore difficult to move or carry.
 
• **Slight** means very small; not important or serious.
 
• **Compact** means small and easy to carry.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
